facts.fact: Starlink has been on sale in Kenya since July 2023.
Subscribers: 24,999 at 2026-03, per the Communications Authority of Kenya, 0.9% of the fixed internet market, 2,717 more than three months earlier.

In early July 2026 Starlink stopped taking new customers in Nairobi, Kiambu, Mombasa, Machakos, Murang'a, Kirinyaga and Kwale counties as at capacity, with a deposit waitlist; a provider suspension, no reopening date, not a regulator ban.

systems.tiers: licence applied for in Kenya; first African ground station being built
